recommended_quick_wins: Region selection: route EU users to eu-west-1 only if their observed RTT < 70ms; else route to eu-central or fallback to us-east-1 with sticky routing
Client timeouts: increase HTTP timeout to 30s for streaming calls; use heartbeat events and resume on reconnect where possible
Prompt guidance: compress system prompt, send short context window (last 2 turns) and push older context to embeddings search
max_tokens: set conservative max_tokens (150-200) for chat replies; use separate async job for long summaries
Streaming: enable streaming to begin token delivery earlier — reduces perceived latency and avoids client timeouts
Batching/caching: enable per-session KV cache for repeated prefixes; batch embedding requests for nightly job to reduce unit cost
Retries: implement idempotent retry with exponential backoff and dedupe on server side to avoid duplicate charges
Monitoring: add 95th/99th pctl traces by region in Console; capture per-route token/time breakdown
